ask: When and where did it first appear?
cards: 27th century BCE · Saqqara, Egypt. Credited to Imhotep.
c. 2000 BCE · Crete. Credited to Minoan civilisation.
2650–1450 BCE · Dholavira, India. Credited to Indus Valley Civilisation.
486 BCE–609 CE · Jiangsu, China. Credited to King Fuchai of Wu, Emperor Yang of Sui, Sui dynasty.
c. 280 BCE · Pharos, Alexandria. Credited to Sostratus of Cnidus, Ptolemaic Empire.
c. 150 BCE · Rome (first in the harbours near Baiae). Credited to Roman Republic.
595–605 · Zhao County, Hebei, China. Credited to Li Chun, Sui dynasty.
984 · Huai’an, Jiangsu, China. Credited to Qiao Weiyue, Song Dynasty.
15th century · The Andes (Peru). Credited to Inca Empire.
1852 · New York. Credited to Elisha Otis, United States.
1885 · Chicago. Credited to William Le Baron Jenney, United States.
